model_output.verdict: A customer success manager with a defined account book and team-wide onboarding work, but questions about renewals remain.
write_up: A recruiter can see your path from payroll support into customer success, with 48 mid-market accounts and regular reviews with finance and HR leads. The resume is likely to move forward, though your part in renewal strategy and payroll escalations could be more explicit.

The onboarding checklist is a strong model: you name what you built and show that the whole CS team uses it. Let’s bring that same detail to your work with Sales and your response when payroll runs fail.
